review.method: Read-only pinned GitHub source and local catalog/static-code inspection. No upstream code was installed or executed.
review.licenseScope: MIT evidence covers first-party code; borrowed renderer/shim, font, WAV files, and legacy dependencies are excluded from runtime.

frameOrder: Run sprites in array order: ship, ten player bullets, three alien bullets, big alien, then asteroids/explosions and appended fragments
Splice sprites marked reap immediately; appended sprites can run during same frame
Draw score, reserve lives, optional framerate; schedule next frame unless paused

left.effect: rotational velocity -6; wins when both left and right held

thrust.effect: acceleration 0.5 toward heading; otherwise zero acceleration and inertial coast

fire.effect: Start from waiting; hold to fire during ship visibility

mute.effect: Toggle original audio muted flag; initially muted

debug.G: Hold to show grid and occupied cells

controls.touch: Original ipad.js supports thrust, left, right and fire buttons only on detected iPad; any document touch sets gameStart. Modern pointer controls replace this adapter.

notes: Collision geometry uses main ship/asteroid/UFO body polygon only, excluding exhaust and decorative top/bottom.
Flat numeric points.reverse() reverses coordinate order AND exchanges x/y within points. It is not equivalent to reversing an array of [x,y] pairs.

ship.softLimiter: Applied per rendered preMove when speed>8, before current-frame acceleration; is not a strict clamp and is refresh-rate dependent.
ship.cooldownOnFullPool: Cooldown resets to10 even when no inactive bullet can be found.
collision: Create explosion at other object's coordinates

alien.name: alienbullet
alien.direction: Uniform random angle on full circle
alien.appearance: 2px line from current position to current position minus velocity

shared.collisionGeometry: A single point at projectile center
shared.onExpiry: time=0, invisible; original leaves stale grid link

asteroids.scoreRule: 120/current scale only for player bullet; no score for ship/UFO/alien bullet.

largeSpawn.safety: Repeat random position until the toroidal 3×3 grid neighborhood is free of visible ship, player bullet, big alien, alien bullet; other asteroids do not block.

fragmentSpawn.preAdvanceDelta: child scale*3; integrates new velocity and spin before being appended

asteroids.onHit: Score if player bullet; divide scale by3; spawn3 children if new scale>0.5; explosion at other object's coordinates; die/reap original.

ufo.offscreenExit: Hide and reposition after x crosses opposite ±20 margin.
ufo.laterArrivalMs: 30000*random, scheduled immediately on activation; timer may be overdue by exit/death.
ufo.activationGuard: Only FSM run, only when currently invisible, strict now>nextBigAlienTime.

steering.firstFrame: preMove returns if no currentNode yet, so no steering or fire until positioned in grid.
steering.measure: Count nonempty cells (not sprites); original nextSprite includes any sprite class and can contain stale hidden members.
steering.tie: 1% chance each rendered frame to negate current vy; zero stays zero.

shooting.heading: Uniform random full-circle direction, not aimed at ship

ufo.onHit: Award200 only for player bullet; explosion at other object; hide and reposition. Original does not clear its grid link.

collisions.broadPhase: Sprite center's toroidal grid cell plus 8 neighbors, each cell storing linked sprites.
collisions.narrowPhase: For each allowed other sprite, test each other transformed vertex against current sprite's path; Firefox fallback uses odd/even ray casting. Mutual collidable polygon classes normally test both directions when each runs, but no explicit edge intersection test.

pairs.result: Ship dies; asteroid splits or is destroyed; no points
Ship dies; UFO disappears/repositions; no points
Asteroid splits/dies; UFO disappears/repositions; no points
Asteroid splits/dies; alien bullet consumed; no points
UFO disappears/repositions; player bullet consumed;200 points

collisions.seams: Ship and asteroids are drawn/tested at neighboring canvas copies in border cells; UFO only vertical copies; bullets move across seams but have no drawn copies.
collisions.wrapRule: When coordinate>edge set0; when<0 setedge. Original drops overshoot rather than modulo preserving it.
collisions.spawnClearance: Same3×3 grid neighborhood and allowed collision names. No distance-based invulnerability, shield or temporary grace period.
collisions.ufoPlayerBulletSeamRule: UFO-versus-player-bullet collision wraps vertically only. Neither class has a horizontal duplicate, and player bullets do not perform an outgoing collision search. Ship/UFO and asteroid/UFO can still collide across horizontal seams through the ship/asteroid duplicate passes.

boot.action: Spawn5 moving attract-mode asteroids; set waiting.

waiting.action: Show start prompt; world still updates.

start.action: Kill existing asteroids; hide player bullets and UFO; reset score0, reserves2, large count2; spawn wave; schedule first UFO; set spawn_ship.
start.originalLeak: Does not clear alien bullets or pooled timer ages/counters.

spawn_ship.action: Set ship center each frame; wait until3×3 collision neighborhood clear; reset rot/vx/vy; show ship; set run.

run.waveCompletion: If no asteroid entries remain, set new_level; no requirement to destroy UFO or projectiles.
run.ufo: Activate invisible UFO when deadline passed; schedule next deadline at activation.

new_level.action: Continue sprite simulation; then increment large count to cap12, spawn, return run.

player_died.otherwise: Continue sprite simulation, wait>1000 ms, then spawn_ship.

end_game.action: Show GAME OVER; continue sprite simulation; clear touch start flag each frame; return waiting after timer.

presentation.background: Original desktop white canvas/black vector strokes

explosion.eachRay: unit vector to twice unit vector

audio.replacement: Planned modern adapter is silent; no upstream audio redistributed.

completenessRequirements: Endless wave clearing with all3 asteroid sizes,3-way fragmentation and cap12 large rocks; report zero finite levels.
Full thrust/rotation/inertial movement, toroidal playfield, inherited player bullet velocity, finite pools and lifetimes.
Seven collision pairs including UFO-vs-rock and alien-bullet-vs-rock, not merely ship/rock and player shooting.
Single large UFO with side entry/exit, cell-based vertical steering, random shots, correct first/subsequent deadlines and200 score.
Three total ship lives with safe-center respawn, death/interwave waits and game-over/restart.
Exact20/60/180 asteroid scoring only on player shots; no invented extra lives or victory.
Distinguish adaptation UI, pointer/keyboard lifecycle, timer/collision repairs and silent audio from original gameplay.
Retain pinned upstream attribution and full MIT in distributed derivative materials; do not ship excluded dependencies/assets.

originalHazardsAndRecommendedDecisions.finding: checkCollision checks other.visible but not this.visible; a first collision can remove/hide this while candidate traversal continues. Ship/projectile callbacks dereference currentNode without guarding null.
originalHazardsAndRecommendedDecisions.impact: Possible repeated death/score/split callbacks or null dereference with multiple overlaps.
originalHazardsAndRecommendedDecisions.decision: Fix: each pair once; stop dead sprite processing immediately; make removal/death idempotent.
originalHazardsAndRecommendedDecisions.evidence: Direct static control-flow risk; not runtime reproduced.

originalHazardsAndRecommendedDecisions.finding: UFO hide/reposition and projectile expiry do not unlink spatial members; restart hides player bullets/UFO without cleanup. Fragment clone carries source sprite's currentNode/nextSprite until updated.
originalHazardsAndRecommendedDecisions.impact: Stale occupancy, changed UFO steering/clearance and unregistered fragments until cell change.
originalHazardsAndRecommendedDecisions.decision: Fix: rebuild occupancy from active sprites or correctly index each fresh entity.

originalHazardsAndRecommendedDecisions.finding: Vertex containment misses pure edge crossings when neither polygon contains a tested vertex; broadphase neighboring cells can also miss marginal overlaps of large polygons.
originalHazardsAndRecommendedDecisions.decision: Use current independent geometry with explicit seam offsets; if adding edge-edge intersections, document collision robustness fix.

originalHazardsAndRecommendedDecisions.finding: Seam drawing temporarily changes x/y without clearing cached transformed points; Firefox fallback can use center-copy points for duplicate-copy collision.
start does not clear alien bullets, bullet ages, ship shot counter, UFO counter/vertical motion or every lifecycle flag.
originalHazardsAndRecommendedDecisions.decision: Fix complete reset; preserve UFO vy/counter between appearances within a run unless intentionally changed.

originalHazardsAndRecommendedDecisions.finding: Physics stops while paused, but Date.now-based deadlines keep elapsing; only lastFrame resets on unpause.
originalHazardsAndRecommendedDecisions.impact: Respawn/wave/UFO/game-over can fire immediately after pause.
originalHazardsAndRecommendedDecisions.decision: Fix by using paused simulation clock; retain nominal1000/5000/30000 timers.

originalHazardsAndRecommendedDecisions.finding: Large elapsed values produce giant movement/rotation steps; one-wrap logic loses overshoot.
originalHazardsAndRecommendedDecisions.impact: Tunnelled collisions or destabilized state after slow/background frames.
originalHazardsAndRecommendedDecisions.decision: Use bounded/substepped dt and clear/freeze on visibility loss; disclose timing repair.

originalHazardsAndRecommendedDecisions.finding: Velocity multiplies.95 once per rendered frame above8, regardless of delta; thrust then adds acceleration.
originalHazardsAndRecommendedDecisions.impact: Different high-speed behavior at different refresh rates.
originalHazardsAndRecommendedDecisions.decision: Preserve source constants; if normalizing to fixed simulation frequency, describe choice. Do not silently substitute hard speed clamp.

originalHazardsAndRecommendedDecisions.finding: new_level, player_died and end_game share FSM.timer. A death during interwave delay may inherit an already running timer.
Global key listeners have no blur cleanup; key-repeat toggles pause/mute/FPS; touch adapter clears shared key state and handles only iPad.
originalHazardsAndRecommendedDecisions.impact: Stuck controls or repeated toggles; poor modern multi-pointer behavior.
originalHazardsAndRecommendedDecisions.decision: Use scoped keyboard/pointer state, edge-trigger toggles, release/cancel/blur cleanup.

originalHazardsAndRecommendedDecisions.finding: Asteroid spawn retries random positions until a3×3 neighborhood is empty, without a limit.
originalHazardsAndRecommendedDecisions.impact: Could stall if no valid region remains.
originalHazardsAndRecommendedDecisions.decision: Use bounded sampling plus deterministic safe-cell fallback or deferred spawn; do not place unsafe rock as hidden shortcut.

originalHazardsAndRecommendedDecisions.finding: Two reserve icons/three total lives; no grace invulnerability; random shooting; activation-based UFO timer; inherited UFO vy/cooldown across appearances; player shots can score during death wait; flat numeric coordinate reversal; no asteroid/asteroid collision.
originalHazardsAndRecommendedDecisions.decision: Keep unless clearly labeled intentional adaptation change.

closest.rules: Horizontal-only fixed-y formation shooter, finite12 authored stages, shelters, shields and telegraphed volleys.
closest.distinct: No rotation/inertial freeflight, toroidal traversal, rock splitting or UFO wave ecology.
Landing goals and terrain/fuel constraints; no combat, asteroid branching or endless waves.

closest.rules: One-button perpendicular thrust with stellar attraction, changing scrolling starfield, distance-from-origin score and accumulated contact damage.
closest.distinct: No firing, destructible targets, finite ammunition pools, three-life respawn or cleared asteroid waves.

uniqueness.verdict: Mechanically distinct from closest existing entries; not a reskin or catalog inflation if full mechanics are carried through.
